message.content: {"basis": "The pie chart titled 'Global Energy Consumption by Source' displays four categories with their consumption shares. The largest category is 'Nuclear' at 40%, which is greater than Hydroelectric (25%), Renewables (20%), and Fossil Fuels (15%). According to the task instructions, the largest category must be routed to priority source monitoring. The option 'Route Nuclear to priority source monitoring' corresponds to this finding.", "option_label": "Route Nuclear to priority source monitoring"}
